{"path":"/results/6_Nov_Optimised/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/subtask_false/level_3/brief/silicon_melting_3_trial_0/in.lammps","content":"# LAMMPS Input Script for Melting Silicon

units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

read_data       silicon.data

# Define potential
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/Si.sw Si

# Replicate the system
replicate       3 3 3

# Define settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    delay 5

timestep        0.001

# Equilibration and heating
thermo          100
thermo_style    custom step temp press pe ke etotal

fix             1 all npt temp 300 2500 2.2 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             100000

# Unfix the npt
unfix           1

# Compute diffusion
compute         msd all msd
variable        diff equal c_msd[4]/(6*step*dt)
thermo_style    custom step temp press v_diff

# Run for diffusion
fix             2 all nve
run             50000
"}
